world.title: Future Hospitality Summit (FHS) Africa Heads to Uganda for the First Time in February 2027
world.description:
Uganda will host the Future Hospitality Summit (FHS) Africa for the first time on 2-3 February 2027, marking a major milestone for the country’s tourism and hospitality sector and reinforcing its ambition to become one of Africa’s leading investment destinations.
The announcement follows a partnership between the Uganda Tourism Board (UTB) and the bench - the organisers of FHS Africa, the continent’s leading hospitality investment platform. The summit will bring together global investors, hotel developers, operators, tourism leaders and government officials to explore opportunities across Uganda’s rapidly expanding hospitality landscape.

science.title: Musk's original 2001 Mars plan was almost childishly simple: land a small greenhouse on the red planet to reignite public excitement for space, the seed idea that grew into SpaceX
science.description: Before SpaceX existed, Elon Musk spent late 2001 trying to buy refurbished Soviet missiles in Moscow to land a minibar-sized greenhouse on Mars. The plan, called Mars Oasis, was designed not to do science but to broadcast a single image — a green shoot against red dirt — back to Earth. When the Russians wouldn't sell cheap, Musk built the rocket company instead.
